entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I see... A bulletin board, huh...?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So the calling card they used for[n]Kamoshida was different...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Now that's a scoop. That kind of[n]information usually doesn't see the light[n]of day.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...You have any photos or videos of it?
Why do you ask?
I don't.
Mishima might...[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You know, for the sake of credibility?[n]Well... I guess a decent photocopy will do.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Huh...? But I thought you were a fan of[n]the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Nice! You have some great connections.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: *chuckle* But seriously, the[n]"Phantom Thieves of Hearts"?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: They sound like kids on a playground,[n]not valiant fighters for society...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I mean, they act all high and mighty,[n]but I'm not sure they're really worth[n]very much in the end.
Worth...?
What about their justice?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Yup. What, you don't think they're really[n]virtuous, do you?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hah, that's hilarious! You think they're actually[n]virtuous?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: In my line of work, there's no clearer[n]sign of deception than goodwill.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You know, like the shady actions of [n]a charitable organization, or the[n]actual criteria of a peace prize.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Same goes for the Phantom Thieves.[n]You just have to learn to take some[n]things with a grain of salt.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: C'mon, don't be such a downer...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Why? It's the truth.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: There you go again... [n]You used to be so positive.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, shut it! I don't care about the past!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Gimme some sushi.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: We're all out.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: ...Hey, why don't you go back to covering[n]politics?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: No can do. I've been permanently[n]reassigned to the culture and[n]entertainment department.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: *sigh* What a crappy company...[n]I mean, it's already been over[n]a year since the incident.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh, by the incident, I mean—

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Don't say another word. That has nothing to[n]do with my source.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh... I'm sorry.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Urgh, dammit! I'm already sobering up.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Gimme a refill, Lala-chan!

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: ...Geez, you're such a child sometimes.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hey, you wanna drink? You can[n]have some of mine if you want.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: ...AHEM.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Whoa... That's some scowl you've got.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Anyway, why are you coming to a bar[n]if you can't even drink alcohol?
I like the atmosphere.
It's for the article.[clr 27]
Tell me about that incident.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Mm, that makes sense. Feel free to[n]visit whenever you want, honey.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Wow, that's seriously the only[n]reason? You're so uptight.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Haha, that's right!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You're a true believer in[n]the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Don't worry about that.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm a journalist and you're my source.[n]There's no reason for us to talk about[n]that stuff.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, at least now I know you're gonna[n]be pretty useful.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm not all that interested in the Phantom[n]Thieves myself, but keep the info coming,[n]all right?
I feel like my bond with[n]Ohya is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...What's taking so long, Lala-chan!?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Where's my drink!? Do they call you[n]Escargot 'cause you move as slow as a snail?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: We're all out of booze... A certain[n]sloshed reporter drank it all.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Can't you just go buy more? I'll[n]wait for you... forever. [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Just kidding! Ahaha!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: See ya later... Don't forget to[n]bring me more juicy info, 'kay?
